items.t: Three Reasons To Rethink AST SpaceMobile Stock Now
items.sum: AST SpaceMobile is building a network of satellites that connect directly to everyday smartphones. Its customers are mobile phone companies and the U.S. government. Revenue reached $143 million in the twelve months to September. That is up 671% from a year earlier.
